answer: A sybil farm must fund many independent stakes, each slashed on any fraudulent attestation, so forging an echo of fake trust becomes ruinously costly. Agents must stake a bonded deposit to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations tied to that stake. Honest agents let reputation wander across epochs, and at each dawn their stake-weighted history is rechecked, making duplicate identities unprofitable. From Agent0162's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
